title: 建立 Skin 可运行工程骨架
objective: 建立可安装、可构建、可启动、可验证的 mc-plan-skin pnpm/TypeScript 工程骨架：apps/web(Next.js)、apps/api(NestJS)、apps/worker(BullMQ) 与 packages/config、contracts、skin-core、skin-validator、provider-sdk、test-fixtures，形成真实 lint、format、typecheck、unit、integration、build、Playwright 冒烟、契约类型生成与 Minecraft 皮肤 fixture 校验命令；不实现业务纵向链路端点。
in_scope: pnpm workspace、TypeScript 严格模式、ESLint/Prettier 与结构化日志、健康检查、环境变量 Schema 验证基线
apps/web 最小可运行页面与构建；apps/api 配置校验与私有健康探针；apps/worker BullMQ worker 骨架

packages/config 运行模式与环境解析；packages/contracts 从已发布 0.1.0-draft 契约生成的客户端类型；packages/skin-core 领域类型基线；packages/skin-validator PNG/64×64/SHA-256 校验；packages/provider-sdk 厂商无关接口与确定性 Fake Provider；packages/test-fixtures 皮肤 fixture 与校验脚本
Prisma/PostgreSQL 基线与 testcontainers 集成测试；Vitest 单测；Playwright 冒烟
AGENTS.md 补充真实验收命令；更新 STATUS.md 与 README
out_of_scope: conversation、render、candidate、finalize 等公共业务端点实现
公共 OpenAPI、JSON Schema 或 SDK 修改
Official 登录、Core 额度、Community 发布、Keycloak、真实 AI 厂商、正式内容审核
3D 预览库选择、生产域名、生产密钥、真实云资源、远程推送
contract_impact: none; packages/contracts only generates client types from the published 0.1.0-draft contract and does not modify it
acceptance_evidence: pnpm install completes with a committed lockfile and every declared command exists and runs
lint, format:check, and typecheck pass with zero errors under TypeScript strict mode
unit tests cover config, skin-validator, provider-sdk (including deterministic fake provider), and skin-core domain invariants
PostgreSQL and Redis testcontainers integration tests pass against real containers
All apps build successfully and the Playwright smoke test drives the web app against the running API health endpoint
Contract type generation from the published skin.yaml succeeds and compiles; the fixture validation script accepts valid 64x64 fixtures and rejects non-PNG, wrong-size, and corrupted samples

direction_exception.authorized_by: MC Plan project owner via explicit 2026-10-01 Skin Standalone early development authorization, registered in ADR-0009
direction_exception.reason: Build the owner-approved restricted Skin Standalone engineering skeleton while mc-plan-core remains the F1 primary project.

validation_results: pnpm install completed with a committed lockfile (720 entries passing pnpm supply-chain policies) using pnpm 11.19.0 on Node 24.15
pnpm check passed end to end: prettier, workspace build of all 10 projects, ESLint with zero warnings, strict TypeScript typecheck, and 58 unit tests
Contract consistency check passed: client types regenerated from skin.yaml 0.1.0-draft match all 4 committed generated artifacts
Minecraft skin fixture validation passed 6/6: valid Steve/Alex accepted with metadata, non-PNG, 32x32, corrupted, and single-layer samples rejected with the declared error codes

API integration test passed against a real testcontainers PostgreSQL: committed baseline migration deployed from scratch, readiness reported current, and Conversation/ConversationMessage/RenderJob/Candidate rows round-tripped
Worker integration test passed against a real testcontainers Redis: 3 BullMQ jobs processed order-independently and an invalid payload job entered the failed state
Playwright smoke passed: real PostgreSQL container + API dist + Next.js dev served the page, the same-origin /api proxy returned 200, and the health badge rendered 正常 under standalone mode
Prisma baseline migration 20261001123216_skin_baseline committed; prisma validate and migration directory integrity checks pass

Engineering deviations documented in AGENTS.md: Nest 12 requires explicit app.init(); API e2e/integration tests run against compiled dist; Next.js dev requires allowedDevOrigins for localhost/127.0.0.1 parity
